action.rationale: Fresh problem with dim=10 and a small budget of 100 (< 20·dim=200). Per probing guidance, run light probes (P1–P3) to read global structure on cheap, deterministic evaluations before committing the remaining ~88 evals.

Budget is small for dim=10 (88 left < 30·dim) and P2 shows strong global structure (fdc_spearman=0.776), favoring TuRBO’s sample efficiency over CMA-ES. We lack P5/P4, so jumping to a local solver is risky; TuRBO can quickly find a good region to later polish.

Only 38 evaluations remain (< round_size 50) and turbo has not improved for 8 evals, so it’s time to refine rather than explore. P2 shows strong global structure (fdc_spearman 0.776), and with no P5 gradients, bobyqa is the safer local polish. This should squeeze local gains from the incumbent 3272.74 efficiently.
